sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.supports: Full methods for 49 of the 55 trophies, and the only guide with a method for the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash and the UFO sighting; its two unconfirmed trophies are stated as beliefs only.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.supports: Full methods for 23 trophies and short notes for 21 more; the only numbered source that flags a stranger race as time-sensitive, and it lists five trophies as unconfirmed.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.supports: Full methods for six trophies and one-line rows for 44 more, with the most detailed 100%-checklist threshold tables of any guide read; five trophies listed as unconfirmed.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies

sources.name: eGamers
sources.supports: No original methods: every method tip is attributed to GTABase or PowerPyx, so its steps are cited to those origins instead; its own contribution is 32 one-line requirement notes.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements, Plus The Hardest Ones

sources.name: GTABase
sources.supports: Full methods for 50 of the 55 trophies, with a Gamerscore value per trophy; five trophies are hint-only or unconfirmed.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)

sources.name: Exophase
sources.supports: List-only for all 55 trophies; deliberately not used for claims because its day-one rarity figures contradict each other.
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.supports: List-only for all 55 trophies, plus real progress counters on exactly 20 of them; cited only where a counter is genuinely used.
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

sources.name: GTA Zone
sources.supports: Full methods for 21 trophies and one-line notes for 29 more; an explicit synthesis of PowerPyx and GTABase rather than an independent guide.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

stages.intro: The platinum only lands once the other 54 are earned, and the longest job on that list is the 100% checklist.
stages.title: GOAL — 100% AND THE PLATINUM

stages.intro: The opening chapter holds the one trophy that can slip away, Lucia's balcony meditation, before Chapter 1 ends.
stages.title: OPENING & CHAPTER 1

stages.intro: The map widens, duo play opens, and the side questlines start marking themselves.
stages.title: CHAPTERS 2–3

stages.intro: Bank vaults, the last story missions and the final mission close the story out.
stages.title: CHAPTER 4 & THE FINALE

stages.intro: Stranger strands, hunting, cards, WAiNK scans and maxing Strength stay open after the story.
stages.title: SIDE CONTENT & LONG GRINDS

stages.intro: Stunts, ranges, races, challenges and vehicles unfog Leonida one activity at a time.
stages.title: ACTIVITIES & THE MAP

stages.intro: One-off stunts and five vague hidden trophies, some with no confirmed method anywhere yet.
stages.title: FREE-ROAM FEATS & MYSTERIES

stages.intro: Robberies, dollars and garages, and then the platinum pops.
stages.title: MONEY & CLEANUP

disagreements.a: About 200 hours: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag, eGamers and GTA Zone all land near 200 hours for the full list.
disagreements.b: 300 hours or more: Push Square's launch-week estimate runs far higher than the measured averages the other guides report.
disagreements.title: Platinum time: about 200 hours or 300+ hours

disagreements.a: Cheats switch off trophies and saving the game, as PowerPyx, OutputLag and GTA Zone all state.
disagreements.b: GTABase says the block lasts only for the current session, the way it worked in GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, and GTA Zone notes the same reading.
disagreements.title: Cheat block: trophies and saving, or session-only

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own in single-player.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops by itself, since it has no requirement of its own beyond the full set in single-player.
Plan around the long tail: the guides put the whole road at roughly 200 hours, with the story taking about 60 of those.
There is no online trophy and no difficulty setting to worry about, so one story playthrough plus free-roam cleanup is enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and the trophy lands on its own.

steps.text: Play through the main mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks automatically when it ends.
Nothing needs preparing beforehand, and there is no way to lock yourself out of it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the next chapter begins.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's main missions until the chapter closes and Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, opens.
It is an automatic story trophy, so keep playing the main missions and it lands on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2's main missions until the chapter closes and Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, opens.
It is automatic and unmissable, with no side content needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops as Chapter 4 begins.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3's main missions until the chapter closes and Chapter 4, Ocean Beach, opens.
It is an automatic story trophy, so keep playing the main missions.

disagreements.a: The finale sits in Chapter 4: PowerPyx says the final mission, Starting From Zero, is in Chapter 4 and gives the same chapter for this trophy.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory, the mission this trophy names, in Chapter 5, and GTA Zone lists Snow Storm the same way.
disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 or Chapter 5

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops with its final main mission.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4: PowerPyx says the trophy pops with the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero.
It is automatic and unmissable, so no extra step is needed beyond the story.

disagreements.a: The finale sits in Chapter 4: PowerPyx says the final mission, Starting From Zero, is in Chapter 4 and gives the same chapter for this trophy.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory, the mission this trophy names, in Chapter 5, and GTA Zone lists Snow Storm the same way.
disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 or Chapter 5

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.short: Play the final story mission through to the end and the gold trophy pops.

steps.text: Play the final story mission to the end; PowerPyx names it Starting From Zero.
Free-roam carries on afterwards, and the trophy depends only on playing that mission through.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners and the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable.

disagreements.a: PowerPyx puts the final mission, Starting From Zero, in Chapter 4 and lists this trophy against the same closing stretch of missions.
disagreements.b: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory, the mission this trophy names, in Chapter 5, and GTA Zone lists Snow Storm the same way.
disagreements.title: Final mission chapter: Chapter 4 or Chapter 5

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops during it.

steps.text: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory, which GTABase places in Chapter 5.
It is automatic and unmissable.

disagreements.a: PowerPyx and GTABase say the robbery rows require everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
disagreements.b: KeenGamer's 100% table gives partial counts inside the robbery types instead, such as 34 of 35 Smash N' Grabs.
disagreements.title: Robberies in full for 100%: everything or partial counts

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.short: Reach 100% on the checklist the game unlocks after the story.

steps.text: Open the checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work through it; progress made during the story already counts.
Clear any 100 optional missions — far more than 100 appear, so the spares cover the missable ones.
Scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK and study 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars.
Finish 70 of the 80 challenges and complete 300 of the 397 stunts.
Complete the all-or-nothing rows in full: all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations.
Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots, scan 100 WAiNK locations and finish 15 of the 18 card sets.
Remember the thresholds are lenient — about 60% true completion — and nothing on the list is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.short: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida.

steps.text: Complete 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest kind, so pick those first when you want fast progress.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration and Stunt Spots.
Keep going past 250, since the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts afterwards.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.short: Try each of the 9 activity types once.

steps.text: Try all 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities.
Filter the map for Activities, marked with the blue dumbbell icon, to find a type you have not tried.
It usually pops on its own while doing other trophies, since most types come up naturally.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

disagreements.a: 12 ranges: GTABase and GTA Zone say the 42 golds sit across 12 ranges, and PowerPyx links a guide to all 12.
disagreements.b: 2 ranges: OutputLag hedges at shooting ranges with 42 gold medals, and Push Square names only two ranges.
disagreements.title: Shooting range locations: 12 ranges or 2 ranges

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.short: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 Shooting Range challenges.
There are 12 ranges holding those 42 golds between them.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, trophy 36.
The medal count is agreed at 42 across the guides, even though the sources differ on how the ranges are counted.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations; winning once per location is enough for the trophy.
The 100% checklist wants 42 drone races across those same 14 spots, so keep racing past the trophy.
PowerPyx counts 42 races across the 14 drone race locations.
Find the spots on the map and work through them in free-roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.short: Win 20 different races.

steps.text: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available.
Winning the same race again does not count; each win has to be a new race.
Mix race types freely — any 20 count toward the total.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

notes.text: Push Square alone adds that Cal asks for a 2kg parrotfish, caught from a boat with a rod — a single-source tip no other guide read repeats.

trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge after working through his questline.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you first meet Cal, watch for his texts about fishing.
Follow Cal's fishing questline until the challenge unlocks.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge itself.
The challenge is only offered once you have worked through Cal's earlier fishing quests.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.short: Complete any one of the four arcade games.

steps.text: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home with the controllers from Chapter 1, and the fourth sits at arcade machines around the world.
To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once; beating every challenge is not needed.
Any of the four games counts, so pick the one you find easiest.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.short: Finish Andy's five-quest line, which only Lucia can run.

steps.text: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville.
Work through the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, then Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The last quest, Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse, awards the trophy.
The quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush once the line is open.
Watch for the questline: it gets marked automatically once Chapter 3 is under way.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

notes.text: Push Square alone names Kenton's final mission Maritime Disputes.

trophies.short: Dive Kenton's seven shipwrecks and bring the treasure back.

steps.text: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls and gets marked on the map.
Dive the purple treasure-chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor.
There are 7 shipwrecks in total; after each set he calls you back and marks more locations.
Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.short: Finish Billy's five jobs, which open after Coffee Break.

steps.text: Billy's questline starts in Chapter 2 after the mission Coffee Break, marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through the five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The last job, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy.
All five jobs stay available after the story.
The jobs get marked automatically once the questline opens.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

notes.text: eGamers alone warns that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress, attributing the claim to TechWiser, whose article could not be verified.

trophies.short: Finish 8 stranger strands that the game counts as strangers.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; only certain questlines count toward the total.
Confirmed counting strands include Kirk and his Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove quests, Kyle McKittrick, Yago and Pilot Pete.
These count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie have their own trophies and do not count as strangers.
Race Against Yago is the one moment OutputLag alone flags as time-sensitive, with an hourglass icon.
Check the trophy's progress counter as strands finish; the strands stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.short: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's wish list.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens in Chapter 3 after the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Deliver 16 sports cars from the list to his garage in the west of Vice City; the first one goes over during the mission itself.
Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list, and look around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach where they park.
Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; it stays doable after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.short: Shut down Tyrone's synthetic labs, Jason-only.

steps.text: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3 after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
Once enough labs are gone, the job Spin On This shuts the labs down and awards the trophy.
It stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

disagreements.a: Possibly one missable: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag, GTA Zone and eGamers all flag this trophy for the Chapter 1 meditation.
disagreements.b: No known missables: Push Square's full trophy guide carries no missable warning anywhere and never mentions the Chapter 1 meditation.
disagreements.title: Missables: one possibly missable or none known

disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase put duo play, and meditation with both characters, at Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.
disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run or after Coffee Break

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.resolvedNote: Resolved: 18 meditations for the trophy, 15 for the 100% list — the two numbers measure different things, and PSNProfiles' 0/18 counter settles the trophy number.
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, both characters together where it counts.

steps.text: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations; Jason and Lucia meditating together counts double at the same spot.
The first meditation is in Chapter 1 at the balcony: after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her out.
That balcony meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it.
The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18, while the trophy itself needs all 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.short: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for.

steps.text: Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 2 after Coffee Break, when Bret texts about meeting him.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks, marked with purple icons, and bring them back to Bret as Jason.
A clean one-shot kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, though it is not required.
Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed, while the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.short: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.

steps.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game.
The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.short: Scan 100 WAiNK locations anywhere in the world.

steps.text: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app by holding up and then R1.
The spots split into 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus Flusher tags.
Any 100 in the world count, so pick the ones nearest your route.
The 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans, so it pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.short: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.

steps.text: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; finished ones show a Completed checkmark.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave the grind until late.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks along the way.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase put duo play, and escaping together, at Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.
disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run or after Coffee Break

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.short: Lose a 4-star wanted level together with your partner.

steps.text: It is possible once Jason and Lucia can play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; call your partner to join you.
Get a 4-star wanted level and escape it; the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone.
The easiest escape is to drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot see you.
It also pops during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, while you are waiting at the cafe.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase put duo play, and robbing together, at Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.
disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run or after Coffee Break

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.short: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while the cops chase you.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Stay at the flashing red-and-blue wanted level the whole time; if the stars fade, the run is over.
A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so wait before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good

notes.text: Push Square alone adds that getting inside a vehicle discovers it without scanning, which the compatible guides contradict.

trophies.short: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them.

steps.text: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app by holding R1; you only need to scan them, not drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan the passing traffic to rack up new vehicles quickly.
Check discovered vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles, so this one comes automatically.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.short: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm; time slows and weak spots are highlighted.
Fill your Focus by eating, drinking or washing at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch each use.
Take down 5 enemies in one use — the thugs at gang operations work well as targets.
It gets easier as Focus levels up; there are 4 levels, raised at shooting ranges, golf and other activities.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.short: Steal a docked passenger plane at VCIA and fly it away.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal's boarding bridge.
The easiest plane is at gates E3 and E4: drive through the fence and use the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport.
Save first — the police come fast once you are inside.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Steal a military tank and shoot enemies with it.

steps.text: Find the military tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west edge of the map.
Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
Save first — the base is guarded.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.short: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first; it unlocks the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on the store's locked back door — kicking it sets the alarm off.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and destroy the security footage.
A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

disagreements.a: Silver: the official list gives 40G, and GTABase, OutputLag, KeenGamer, eGamers, GTA Zone, PSNProfiles and PlanetGTA6 all agree it is Silver.
disagreements.b: Bronze: Push Square alone lists Maximum Withdrawal as Bronze — the only grade dissent found in any source.
disagreements.title: Maximum Withdrawal grade: Silver or Bronze

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.short: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, waiting at the cafe, which introduces vault robberies.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then go in quickly while the guard has the vault open.
You cannot carry the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand over a bag.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape fast on a motorcycle.
Only 5 of the 8 vaults are needed for the trophy, but all 8 count for the 100% list and pay up to $205,000 each through Yasmani.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat.

steps.text: Robbing a bank vault counts too: the same mission that opens vaults also counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail one to the bank.
Vaults unlock after the cafe mission; near a bank you can also find an armored truck, block it and plant a sticky bomb on its back door.
The trophy pops once you escape the red heat zone — a Pay n' Spray helps you drop the heat.
All 8 Large Bank Jobs are needed for the 100% list, so this one comes automatically.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.short: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida.

steps.text: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida, all 52 areas.
The fastest way is by plane: fly over every dark patch until the entire map is visible.
The map unfogs as you travel, so much of it finishes naturally while doing everything else.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.short: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.

steps.text: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; operations show as yellow icons when you go near them.
Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs.
Only 1 operation per gang is needed for the trophy, while the 100% list needs all 39, so it pops on the way.
Many operations get marked automatically as the story progresses.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.
disagreements.b: The exact steps are unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase and GTA Zone list the trigger as unconfirmed, and eGamers repeats the same uncertainty.
disagreements.title: Method known or unconfirmed

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.short: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it by the bar.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini there.
Drink it while standing next to the bar.
Five other guides list the trophy as unconfirmed, so this single-source method from PowerPyx is shown as the only method found.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City, which needs the Key Cloner.
disagreements.b: The exact steps are unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase and GTA Zone list the trigger as unconfirmed, and eGamers repeats the same uncertainty.
disagreements.title: Method known or unconfirmed

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.short: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and smash it out through the window.

steps.text: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City; any other car will not work.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed and comes as you drive further away down the street; this is a single-source method from PowerPyx.

counter.label: key valuables stolen at Kingpin Bowling

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.short: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation that gets marked during Chapter 2.
Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation; you need them to blow the safe open.
Take the 3 key valuables: the Luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland shotgun in the north-east corner and the safe loot.
The trophy pops once you escape the police after the third item; you do not need all three in one visit.

disagreements.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2: PowerPyx and GTABase put duo play, and training together, at Coffee Break.
disagreements.b: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.
disagreements.title: Duo-play unlock point: after Breakfast Run or after Coffee Break

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.short: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: You can only start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between the characters.
Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia; check it under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength.
Buy a gym membership and always train together: while you work out with one character, the other completes their training too.
Filter the map for fitness clubs with the dumbbell icon; you can also train at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

notes.text: The 500 figure traces to GTABase as its single origin, and PSNProfiles' 0/500 counter confirms the number independently from platform data.

trophies.short: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; robberies and enemy encounters all count.
Turn Criminal Profile notifications on under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so you can see each action land.
It usually comes naturally while working on the other trophies, on the way toward the Irredeemable profile.
If anything is missing at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.short: Not pinned down yet — the only lead ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.

steps.text: No source has a method for this trophy; PowerPyx's lead is only a stated belief that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Treat it as not pinned down yet: keep playing, watch for updates, and do not grind anything on this lead alone.

disagreements.a: A specific method is known: PowerPyx says complete the UFO Easter Egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
disagreements.b: The exact steps are unconfirmed: OutputLag, KeenGamer, GTABase and GTA Zone list the trigger as unconfirmed, and eGamers repeats the same uncertainty.
disagreements.title: Method known or unconfirmed

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Complete the UFO sighting on the road north-west of Starlet Motel after 2AM.

steps.text: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and go alone.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns.
Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky.
Offer to help the woman it drops, then go back to her car at the roadside; this is a single-source method from PowerPyx.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.short: Not pinned down yet — the only lead is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

steps.text: No source has a method for this trophy; PowerPyx's lead is only a stated belief that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
Treat it as not pinned down yet: the description points at a melee drive-by, but the exact trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.short: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's Crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills; it counts across robberies, not all at once.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, once they unlock in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend $100,000 across all the shops.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops; the running total is what counts.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way through, since they are the most expensive.
The shops counted include 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay n' Sprays and 24 Ammu-Nations, among others.
It builds naturally while buying gear for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes

notes.text: Push Square alone names the 8 garages and their prices, summing to exactly $160,000 — starting with Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000.

trophies.short: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app.

steps.text: Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
The app unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, stealing the Crawler for Moses.
Only the 8 purchasable garages count; the 4 story garages do not.
Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot

notes.text: Push Square presents Pay n' Spray and Mod Shop registration as the general method, without the Moses tracker staging — compatible with the guides read.

trophies.short: Register 10 stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses, taking a vehicle to him.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click Respray and then Register.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay n' Spray.
You need free garage space first — see Little Boxes — and registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
